title: Military Divisions and Officers

questions.question: How many men were in each division that served the king?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 27:1 (ESV): "...in all the divisions... The number of a division was 24,000."

questions.question: Who was in charge of the first division for the first month?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 27:2 (ESV): "Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel was in charge of the first division..."

questions.question: Who was the commander of the second division?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 27:4 (ESV): "And in charge of the division for the second month was Dodai the Ahohite..."

questions.question: Who was in charge of the third division?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 27:5 (ESV): "The third commander... was Benaiah the son of Jehoiada..."

questions.question: Who was the commander of the fourth division?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 27:7 (ESV): "The fourth... was Asahel the brother of Joab..."

questions.question: Who was over the tribes of Israel (Reubenites)?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 27:16 (ESV): "...chief officer of the Reubenites was Eliezer the son of Zichri..."

questions.question: Why did David not count those below twenty years of age?
options: Because the LORD had promised to make Israel as many as the stars of heaven
questions.correctAnswer: Because the LORD had promised to make Israel as many as the stars of heaven
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 27:23 (ESV): "David did not count those below twenty years of age, for the LORD had promised to make Israel as many as the stars of heaven."

questions.question: Who was over the king’s treasuries?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 27:25 (ESV): "Over the king's treasuries was Azmaveth the son of Adiel..."

questions.question: Who was over the vineyards?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 27:27 (ESV): "and over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite..."

questions.question: Who was the King’s friend?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 27:33 (ESV): "...and Hushai the Archite was the king's friend."

questions.question: Who succeeded Ahithophel?
options: Jehoiada the son of Benaiah and Abiathar
questions.correctAnswer: Jehoiada the son of Benaiah and Abiathar
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 27:34 (ESV): "Ahithophel was succeeded by Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar."

questions.question: Who was over the olive and sycamore trees in the Shephelah?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 27:28 (ESV): "Over the olive and sycamore trees in the Shephelah was Baal-hanan the Gederite..."

questions.question: Who was the commander of the king’s army?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 27:34 (ESV): "...Joab was commander of the king's army."

key_verse_text: David did not count those below twenty years of age, for the LORD had promised to make Israel as many as the stars of heaven.
